uk_gdpr_compliance_package.regulations: UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) & Data Protection Act 2018
uk_gdpr_compliance_package.dpia_justification: A formal Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) is statutory mandatory because the application involves large-scale processing of special category data (Article 9) and automated AI/LLM consultation workflows.

mandates.title: Lawful Basis for Standard Processing
mandates.statutory_requirement: Personal data (Name, Email, Phone, Billing) must be processed under Article 6(1)(b) (Performance of Contract) for delivering services, or Article 6(1)(a) (Consent) for optional marketing and cookies.
mandates.risk_if_unaddressed: Unlawful processing under ICO regulations. Statutory fine up to £17.5M or 4% of annual turnover.

mandates.title: Explicit Consent for Special Category Consultation Data
mandates.statutory_requirement: Codebase stores sensitive data (health/religious/spiritual/astrological context) in models: KundliConsultationModel. Processing is strictly prohibited under Article 9(1) unless an Article 9(2) exception applies. Action Required: Implement separate, unbundled EXPLICIT CONSENT checkbox at booking: 'I explicitly consent to the processing of my personal health/spiritual consultation data in accordance with the Privacy Notice.'
mandates.risk_if_unaddressed: Severe enforcement priority for UK ICO. Fines up to £17.5M and mandatory processing suspension orders.

mandates.title: Mandatory Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)
mandates.statutory_requirement: Third-party subprocessors detected in code (OpenAI LLC, Stripe Payments UK, Ltd., Amazon Web Services (AWS), Twilio Inc., PostHog Inc.). Under Article 28, Tara must maintain written, legally binding DPAs binding each processor to process data only on documented instructions, ensure confidentiality, and delete data on termination.
mandates.risk_if_unaddressed: Direct violation of Article 28. Fines up to £8.7M.

mandates.title: UK International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA) / SCCs
mandates.statutory_requirement: UK customer consultation and profile data accessed by development, support, or practitioner teams in India, or US cloud subprocessors (OpenAI, AWS, Twilio), constitutes a restricted international transfer. Statutory Mandate: Execute the UK ICO International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA) or the UK Addendum to EU SCCs along with a Transfer Risk Assessment (TRA).
mandates.risk_if_unaddressed: Unlawful international data export. Immediate ICO regulatory stop order on overseas data access.

mandates.title: Practitioner Data Minimisation & At-Rest Encryption
mandates.statutory_requirement: Ensure database fields storing special category and consultation transcripts use AES-256 encryption. Furthermore, practitioners must NEVER have access to customer personal contact phone numbers or raw email addresses. Implement in-app calling / masked messaging to prevent practitioner client poaching and off-platform data leakage.
mandates.risk_if_unaddressed: Major data breach vulnerability; unauthorized external data leak requiring 72-hour ICO notification.

developer_remediation_checklist.requirement: Implement data masking on practitioner API views to prevent customer contact theft.
developer_remediation_checklist.code_action: Strip customer phone number and email from practitioner response payloads. Route communications via in-app relay.

developer_remediation_checklist.requirement: Implement DELETE /api/user/account statutory right to erasure (Article 17).
developer_remediation_checklist.code_action: Create soft-delete workflow that scrubs PII across database tables and informs subprocessors within 30 days.

developer_remediation_checklist.requirement: Configure OpenAI zero-data retention headers and sanitize prompt payloads.
developer_remediation_checklist.code_action: Scrub direct names, phone numbers, and addresses from prompt text before dispatching to external LLMs.

developer_remediation_checklist.requirement: Implement field-level encryption for sensitive consultation notes.
developer_remediation_checklist.code_action: Use SQLAlchemy TypeDecorator or database pgcrypto / KMS envelope for sensitive columns.

mandates.title: Itemised Bilingual Notice & Unconditional Consent
mandates.statutory_requirement: Before or at the time of collecting personal data, Tara (Data Fiduciary) must present an itemised notice specifying the personal data to be collected, purpose of processing, how to exercise rights, and grievance officer contacts. Notice must be accessible in clear language with option for English and 22 Indian scheduled languages.
mandates.statutory_penalty: Penalties up to ₹50 Crore for failure to issue compliant statutory notice.

mandates.title: Reasonable Security Safeguards & Immediate Breach Reporting
mandates.statutory_requirement: The Data Fiduciary must implement reasonable security safeguards (encryption, role-based access, access logging) to prevent personal data breaches. In case of ANY breach, immediate notification to the Data Protection Board of India (DPBI) and affected individuals is mandatory.
mandates.statutory_penalty: Maximum statutory fine of ₹250 CRORE (~£25 Million) for failure to implement reasonable security safeguards!

mandates.title: Mandatory Erasure upon Purpose Fulfillment or Consent Withdrawal
mandates.statutory_requirement: Personal data must be erased as soon as the user withdraws consent or as soon as the purpose for which it was collected is no longer being served. The codebase must not retain consultation transcripts indefinitely.
mandates.statutory_penalty: Penalties up to ₹100 Crore for non-compliance with data erasure duties.

mandates.title: Children's Data Verification & Prohibition of Behavioural Tracking
mandates.statutory_requirement: If the platform serves individuals under 18 years, Tara must obtain verifiable parental consent. Strict statutory prohibition against behavioural monitoring, tracking, or targeted advertising directed at children.
mandates.statutory_penalty: Penalties up to ₹200 Crore for breach of obligations in relation to children.

mandates.title: Significant Data Fiduciary (SDF) Readiness Check
mandates.statutory_requirement: Given the sensitive nature of consultation & astrological profiling data, the Central Government may notify Tara as a Significant Data Fiduciary (SDF). SDF obligations require: (1) Appointing a resident India Data Protection Officer (DPO), (2) Appointing an Independent Data Auditor, and (3) Conducting periodic DPIAs.
mandates.statutory_penalty: Penalties up to ₹150 Crore for SDF non-compliance.

mandates.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer & Payment Localisation
mandates.statutory_requirement: Personal data can be transferred outside India unless sent to blacklisted jurisdictions notified by the Indian Government. Payment transaction data processed via Razorpay or UPI must adhere to RBI mandate ensuring full end-to-end transaction data remains stored exclusively in servers located in India.

developer_action_points.action: Expose an in-app Grievance Redressal Officer contact and ticket submission workflow (Section 13).
Ensure withdrawing consent (e.g. user toggles off data use in settings) triggers background job to cease processing.
Verify Indian banking/UPI payment logs are maintained within AWS India (ap-south-1) or Razorpay native storage.
